models.name: elastic_structured_full
models.mechanism: Elastic-net shrinkage can share weak additive evidence across safe calendar, categorical, historical-support, and novelty signals.
models.falsification: Reject if it fails to beat the reconstructed champion robust PR-AUC or loses more than 5% Recall@Top-5%.

models.name: elastic_no_categories
models.mechanism: Explicit ablation of opening-time sparse categorical identity from the elastic model.
models.falsification: Falsify categorical value if removal does not reduce robust PR-AUC or operational recall.

models.name: elastic_no_history_novelty
models.mechanism: Explicit ablation of point-in-time outcome backoff and novelty/support features.
models.falsification: Falsify historical/novelty value if removal does not reduce robust PR-AUC or operational recall.

models.name: elastic_no_volume_context
models.mechanism: Explicit ablation of prior-day and rolling-volume context while preserving deterministic calendar features.
models.falsification: Falsify volume-context value if removal does not reduce robust PR-AUC or operational recall.

models.name: linear_svm_structured
models.mechanism: A maximum-margin sparse ranker may outperform likelihood optimization under extreme imbalance.
models.falsification: Reject if monthly paired wins or operational recall do not improve.

models.name: extra_trees_structured
models.mechanism: Randomized bagged trees may capture discontinuous interactions without boosting's sequential focus on rare positives.
models.falsification: Reject if gains are unstable or Recall@Top-5% degrades by more than 5%.

models.name: hist_gradient_boosting_structured
models.mechanism: Regularized histogram boosting may generalize differently from the deep locked XGBoost champion.
models.falsification: Reject if it cannot improve paired robust PR-AUC with stable workload.

models.name: xgboost_safe_reconstruction
models.mechanism: Reconstruct the locked XGBoost without the temporally uncertain assignment group to isolate model-family versus feature effects.
models.falsification: Use as a safe boosting reference; reject as a promotion if it fails the complete gate.

models.name: word_tfidf_logistic
models.mechanism: Reconstruct the retained lexical mechanism without champion blending to isolate its contribution.
models.falsification: Reject standalone text if it loses operational recall or paired temporal stability.

models.name: word_char_tfidf_svm
models.mechanism: Character shapes should generalize templated alert variants and identifiers that word tokenization fragments.
models.falsification: Reject if character augmentation fails to improve robust PR-AUC over word-only text with non-degraded recall.

models.name: nbsvm_word_char
models.mechanism: Class-conditional log-count ratios can amplify rare violation-associated lexical patterns before a regularized linear fit.
models.falsification: Reject if the NB transform fails to improve over the plain word/character margin model or destabilizes Top-5% recall.

models.name: hybrid_nbsvm_xgboost
models.mechanism: Equal-weight rank blend of NB-SVM lexical and safe XGBoost structured signals.
models.falsification: Reject if it fails the full promotion gate or adds no robust value over both components.
